### A Sure Sign of Spiritual Decline
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-october-20-2022.html
Passage: Genesis 13:12
Points:
- Moving away from godly fellowship is a reliable indicator of personal spiritual drift.
- Lot gradually compromised by pitching his tents toward Sodom while Abram drew closer to God.
- God allows sudden crises and obstacles to serve as wake-up calls when believers head toward trouble.
- Conscience functions as an early warning alarm when we begin drifting into questionable places.
- God will not override human free will, but He continually urges believers to heed His guidance.

### Abram Settled
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abram-settled
Passage: Genesis 13:12
Points:
- Abram demonstrated peaceable generosity and faith in God's promise by yielding first choice to Lot.
- Lot acted selfishly by claiming the fertile Jordan plain entirely for himself.
- Outwardly lush and appealing surroundings masked deep moral and spiritual corruption in Sodom.
- Choosing purely by physical sight led Lot into grave, unconsidered spiritual danger.
- Believers must evaluate life choices based on spiritual well-being rather than superficial advantages.
